articles.headline: Netflix, SpaceX, Alphabet, Alcoa and Intuitive Surgical: Why These 5 Stocks Are on Investors' Radars Today
articles.summary: NFLX, SPCX, GOOG, AA, ISRG were among the trending stocks on Thursday, July 16, 2026.
articles._summary: Major U.S. indices ended Thursday in the red, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipping 0.2% to 52,552.97. The S&P 500 declined 0.51% to 7,533.77, while the Nasdaq dropped 1.47% to 25,881.95. Across U.S. equity markets, trading was mixed beneath the surface at midday, with gains in defensive and value stocks offsetting weakness in chipmakers and speculative technology shares, prompting a rotation into smaller-cap stocks.
articles._zh_headline: Netflix、SpaceX、Alphabet、Alcoa 和 Intuitive Surgical：为什么这 5 只股票今天受到投资者关注
articles._zh_summary: 美国主要股指周四收跌，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 0.2%，至 52,552.97 点。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.51%，至 7,533.77 点；纳斯达克指数下跌 1.47%，至 25,881.95 点。整个美国股市午盘交易涨跌互现，防御性股票和价值型股票的上涨抵消了芯片制造商和投机性科技股的疲软，促使资金转向小盘股。

articles.author: Aniket Verma
articles.headline: SpaceX Stock to Close Higher by July End? Probability on Crypto Prediction Market Falls From 61% to 32%
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency bettors are increasingly expecting Space Exploration Technologies Corp. to close lower by the end of July, as the stock continues to trade below its IPO price amid renewed selling pressure.
articles._summary: Cryptocurrency bettors are increasingly expecting Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ: SPCX ) to close lower by the end of July, as the stock continues to trade below its IPO price amid renewed selling pressure. The probability of SPCX closing higher has dropped sharply from 61% last week to 32% at the time of writing. Note that SPCX finished at $170.86 on June 30. For an “Up” resolution, the stock must equal or beat $170.86 by the market close on July 31.
articles._zh_headline: SpaceX 股价将在 7 月底收高？加密货币预测市场的概率从 61% 下降至 32%
articles._zh_summary: 加密货币押注者越来越多地预计 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）将在 7 月底收盘走低，因为该股在新的抛售压力下继续低于其 IPO 价格。 SPCX 收高的概率已从上周的 61% 大幅下降至撰写本文时的 32%。请注意，SPCX 6 月 30 日收盘价为 170.86 美元。对于“上涨”决议，该股票必须在 7 月 31 日收盘时等于或高于 170.86 美元。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: SanDisk's 40% Drop From Peak: Value Trap or Once-in-a-Generation Buy?
articles.summary: SanDisk trades at 7.9x forward earnings after a 40% drop. History says memory stocks look cheapest right before earnings break.
articles._summary: Two investors can look at the same number — 7.9 times earnings — and reach opposite conclusions. One sees the cheapest SanDisk Corp. (NASDAQ: SNDK ) has ever been. The other sees the oldest trap in semiconductors. As of Thursday, July 16, SanDisk sits 39.1% below the record of $2,351.37 it set in late June, and its forward price-to-earnings ratio — the share price divided by what analysts expect the company to earn over the next twelve months, a rough measure of how expensive a stock is — has fallen to 7.9x.
articles._zh_headline: SanDisk 股价较峰值下跌 40%：价值陷阱还是千载难逢的买入机会？
articles._zh_summary: 两个投资者可以看到相同的数字（市盈率 7.9 倍）并得出相反的结论。人们看到了闪迪公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）有史以来最便宜的价格。另一个看到了半导体中最古老的陷阱。截至 7 月 16 日星期四，SanDisk 的股价比 6 月底创下的 2,351.37 美元的纪录低了 39.1%，其预期市盈率（股价除以分析师预计该公司未来 12 个月的盈利，粗略衡量股票价格的指标）已降至 7.9 倍。

articles.author: Chris Katje
articles.headline: X-Energy Stock: Nuclear Company Becomes Cathie Wood’s New Favorite Position
articles.summary: Cathie Wood has been scooping up shares of this nuclear company in recent days.
articles._summary: Ark Invest, led by Cathie Wood , has been building big positions in a new IPO across three ETFs. While Ark Invest is buying shares of the recent IPO SpaceX , this is another name with purchasing dating back to April 2026. The stock opened for trading at $30.11 and closed at $29.20. Not counting the recent weekend (July 11, July 12), Ark Invest has added XE stock to three ETFs in four straight trading sessions.
articles._zh_headline: X-Energy 股票：核能公司成为 Cathie Wood 的新宠
articles._zh_summary: 由 Cathie Wood 领导的 Ark Invest 一直在三只 ETF 的新 IPO 中建立大量头寸。虽然 Ark Invest 正在购买最近 IPO 的 SpaceX 的股票，但这是另一个名字，购买时间可以追溯到 2026 年 4 月。该股开盘价为 30.11 美元，收盘价为 29.20 美元。不算最近的周末（7月11日、7月12日），Ark Invest已连续四个交易日将XE股票添加到三只ETF中。

articles.headline: Here's How Much $1000 Invested In Tesla 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
articles.summary: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) has outperformed the market over the past 10 years by 25.14% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 38.35%. Currently, Tesla has a market capitalization of $1.46 trillion.
articles._summary: Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA ) has outperformed the market over the past 10 years by 25.14% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 38.35%. Currently, Tesla has a market capitalization of $1.46 trillion. Buying $1000 In TSLA: If an investor had bought $1000 of TSLA stock 10 years ago, it would be worth $26,040.58 today based on a price of $389.17 for TSLA at the time of writing.

articles._zh_summary: 特斯拉（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）过去 10 年的年化表现优于市场 25.14%，平均年回报率为 38.35%。目前，特斯拉市值为1.46万亿美元。购买 1000 美元的 TSLA：如果投资者 10 年前购买了 1000 美元的 TSLA 股票，那么根据撰写本文时 TSLA 的价格为 389.17 美元，该股票今天的价值为 26,040.58 美元。
